name: Utah
agency: Utah Department of Public Safety, Driver License Division
permitAge: 15 (Utah Code 53-3-210.5; permit valid 18 months). Secondary sources say the applicant must be enrolled in driver education.

teen.holdPermit: 6 months (90 days if 19 or older) (secondary sources)
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. unless with licensed driver 21+ in front seat, to/from work, home from school activity, or emergency; age cutoff of this rule conflicts between sources (until 17 vs. under 18)
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: no passengers for the first six months unless a licensed driver 21+ is in the front seat or an emergency (one source exempts immediate family)
teen.phone: Under 18: may not use a wireless phone to talk while driving (Utah Code 41-8-4). All drivers: no handheld texting, reading, browsing, video or data entry (Utah Code 41-6a-1716); voice calls and hands-free allowed.

bac.under21: Not a drop: any measurable alcohol (Utah Code 53-3-231)

notes: Knowledge test: never-licensed 50-question closed-book; previously licensed 25-question open-book (DLD page via search snippet). Pass 80% (Utah Admin. Code R708-39-4).
Knowledge test offered in Spanish and other common languages; Driving Privilege Card applicants do not qualify for translated test (DLD page via search snippet; TownLift 2023).
80 mph posted on some rural interstate stretches (I-15, I-80) since 2013; not on the Wasatch Front.
Left lane: use only to pass or enter HOV lane; must move right for overtaking traffic (Utah Code 41-6a-704).
Move over (Utah Code 41-6a-904): emergency, maintenance and tow vehicles with flashing lights; move over if safe, otherwise slow down and give space. Fine $160 (KPCW Nov 2025).
School bus: on a highway divided by a median or barrier, oncoming traffic need not stop; traffic behind must stop (secondary source).
Left on red only from one-way to one-way.
Insurance: liability 30/65/25 for policies issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2025 (HB 113, 2023); PIP $3,000 (no-fault state).
Handbook is Form DLD-42 published by DLD; a 2023 PDF path under dld.utah.gov was mentioned but not verified, so the URL is left null. Spanish handbook claimed only by third-party driving-tests.org.
